title: Add proof-skills as a federated marketplace entry
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-437, operator ruling 2026-09-25: MIT-license and publish proof-skills under Opum AI in the public opum-marketplace). proof-skills is a new public repo (github.com/opum-ai/proof-skills) shipping four skills (formal-verify, tlaplus-model, lean-model, proof-simplify) for TLA+/Lean formal verification. Layout question (git-subdir vs repo-root) was measured here and settled by opum-agent: repo-root, matching the existing three entries and the layout OMARK-72 proved for both Claude Code and Codex CLI. Pin v0.1.1 (repo-root layout); v0.1.0 (plugins/ subdir layout) stays published but unpinned, never re-cut. Independently verified against opum-ai/proof-skills before this task: tag v0.1.1 object eb96f9681363f34d369612059814e17a300afd8f peels to commit 578749fd8baa6456d89d7a0037c88bc09a89213d (== main HEAD), root tree carries .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name proof-skills, version 0.1.1, author Opum AI/https://github.com/opum-ai, MIT) and skills/ at root (subtree 24b1cbc1685248b1a3b2a30ffb2b854a43efd050).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A plugins[] entry named "proof-skills" exists in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with source {source:"github", repo:"opum-ai/proof-skills", ref:"v0.1.1"}, author {name:"Opum AI", url:"https://github.com/opum-ai"}, category set, and homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/proof-skills
scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records a proof-skills baseline for v0.1.1 with an independently-resolved skills/ subtree SHA, not the relayed one taken on trust
node scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs both report proof-skills checked/verified (not skipped) against the live tag
node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check passes after regenerating .agents/plugins/marketplace.json for the new entry
The marketplace description and README.md describe four plugins, not two, including proof-skills
check · manifests and lore check are green in CI on the PR head SHA

PR opened, required checks green, task closed inside that PR before merge, dev promoted to main; report task id, origin/main SHA, and confirmation the content check and Codex generation ran on it back to opum-agent
